_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Every key is optional: anything absent falls back to the defaults in vodpipe/config.py. You can also set secrets in the dashboard instead of here, or via the DEEPGRAM_API_KEY / TWITCH_OAUTH_TOKEN / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / KIMI_API_KEY / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY / OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY environment variables. network.proxy is an optional HTTP/SOCKS proxy (e.g. socks5://127.0.0.1:1080) used for live capture, VOD download and live-status probes -- set it to reach Twitch and record source quality from a region it has left, such as South Korea, without a full VPN. Rundown engines -- provider: claude-cli | cli | anthropic-api | kimi-api | deepseek-api | openai-api | openai-compatible | none. model names the model for whichever provider is selected; leave it blank for that provider's default. base_url is only for openai-compatible (any OpenAI-shaped endpoint, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1). cli_command is only for cli, which is how a ChatGPT or Gemini subscription is used -- the transcript arrives on the command's stdin, and a {system} token in an argument receives the instruction.
